download_oneigbench_dataset: download the OneIG-Bench dataset from HuggingFace and save prompts to a JSONL file
load_prompts_from_jsonl: load all OneIG-Bench prompts from the downloaded JSONL file into a lookup dictionary
get_prompt_by_id_and_category: get a specific prompt by its ID and category from the OneIG-Bench dataset
create_compound_lookup_key: create a compound lookup key from a prompt ID and category string
review_oneigbench_module: review the OneIG-Bench source module functions for downloading and querying image generation prompts
